measure.measure_definition: Measured value: mean home systolic blood pressure (mmHg) over the home monitoring days of a scheduled visit, reported as the mean at baseline, the mean at week 12 and the mean within-group change from baseline to week 12, together with the adjusted between-group difference at week 12; Participants; Home blood pressure monitoring according to current guideline recommendations; participants were instructed in appropriate BP measurement (Supplementary Content S3) and recorded BP over seven consecutive days with duplicate measurements in the morning and evening (minimum of three consecutive days) using a validated BP monitor. Data were self-reported via remote ePRO at baseline, week 4, week 8 and week 12.; Uncontrolled hypertension at inclusion was defined as mean home systolic BP >135 mmHg. The week-12 mean systolic BP is the primary outcome. Within-group change = week 12 minus baseline. Adjusted between-group differences (intervention minus control) were estimated by ANCOVA in the intention-to-treat set using MICE multiple imputation, adjusting for baseline systolic BP, age, gender, baseline weight and changes in antihypertensive medication.
measure.measure_name: Systolic blood pressure measured by home blood pressure monitoring (HBPM)

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: mean home diastolic blood pressure (mmHg) over the home monitoring days of a scheduled visit, reported as the mean at baseline, the mean at week 12 and the mean within-group change from baseline to week 12, together with the adjusted between-group difference at week 12; Participants; Home blood pressure monitoring over seven consecutive days with duplicate morning and evening measurements (minimum of three consecutive days) using a validated BP monitor, self-reported via remote ePRO at baseline, week 4, week 8 and week 12; identical measurement procedure to systolic BP (Supplementary Content S3).; Mean home diastolic BP at week 12 is a secondary outcome. Within-group change = week 12 minus baseline. Adjusted between-group differences (intervention minus control) were estimated by ANCOVA in the intention-to-treat set using MICE multiple imputation, adjusting for baseline values of the respective outcome, age and gender.
measure.measure_name: Diastolic blood pressure measured by home blood pressure monitoring (HBPM)

measure.measure_definition: Absolute body weight assessed at baseline and week12. Body weight was remotely self-reported by ePRO at baseline,weeks4,8,12 and summarized as mean andSD. Table2 labels the row Weight change(%), with absolute weight summaries in the baseline/week12 columns and baseline-relative percentages in change/adjusted-contrast columns. The unit of the absolute weight summaries is not separately specified in the supplied article,supplement or registry; no kg unit or conversion is inferred.

population.intervention: Oviva Direkt Hypertension (CE-marked, app-based multimodal lifestyle intervention: self-monitoring, self-management and education on weight reduction, low-carbohydrate and low-salt diet based on DASH principles, physical activity, stress management, alcohol reduction, meal plans) plus care as usual (usual treatment within the German healthcare system, primarily antihypertensive medication, and an educational brochure from the Deutsche Hochdruckliga)
population.intervention_regimen: Not reported; 12 weeks of app access in addition to care as usual; self-guided use following in-app instructions; one support call from an Oviva contact person within the first two weeks; ongoing support via in-app chat or telephone. Antihypertensive treatment was stable at entry and medication changes were recorded at all follow-up study visits.
population.population_definition: Randomised allocation (1:1, block randomisation without stratification) to the app-based multimodal lifestyle intervention plus care as usual; analysed as intention-to-treat; Adults aged 18–75 years with essential hypertension and mean home systolic BP >135 mmHg measured with a validated device, on stable antihypertensive treatment for at least three months with fewer than four antihypertensive drugs, randomised to the intervention arm. All randomised participants are included in the intention-to-treat analysis irrespective of treatment discontinuation (3 participants discontinued treatment: 2 lack of time to complete study procedures, 1 burden due to planned surgery).
population.population_name: Intervention group: Oviva Direkt Hypertension plus care as usual (ITT)

population.intervention_regimen: Not reported; Care as usual for 12 weeks; antihypertensive treatment stable at entry; medication changes recorded at all follow-up study visits.
population.population_definition: Randomised allocation (1:1, block randomisation without stratification) to care as usual alone; analysed as intention-to-treat; Adults aged 18–75 years with essential hypertension and mean home systolic BP >135 mmHg measured with a validated device, on stable antihypertensive treatment for at least three months with a planned eligibility criterion of fewer than four antihypertensive drugs, randomised to the control arm. All randomised participants are included in the intention-to-treat analysis; no participant in this group discontinued treatment.
